expected.raw_text: 2+ years shipping LLM-based products to real users in production
Security Mindset: You treat access to enterprise data as part of the design, not an afterthought

parsed.notes:
The introductory description explicitly asks for a builder who can move between prompt engineering, backend systems, and model optimization, so these are candidate qualifications rather than responsibilities alone.
The Nice to Have heading makes its technical qualifications optional; its three framework examples form one alternative group.
Open-weight models are provisionally mapped to open-source-llms; open weights do not necessarily imply open-source licensing, so this mapping is flagged.
Generic model optimization is not narrowed to inference optimization. Systems engineering is not assumed to mean distributed systems.
Technologies appearing only under What You'll Do are excluded. Failure-mode examples do not independently establish requirements for APIs, agents, or hallucination detection.
Enterprise Operations and its industry examples are domain knowledge, not skills under this guide.
Founding is not a defined seniority level, and architect describes a responsibility here; seniority is inferred from the explicit seven-year requirement.
